svg.title: LinuxCNC HAL pipeline architecture — ProjectSheetCake
svg.desc: Two textbook pipeline diagrams: the X-axis servo control pipeline sequenced by addf in the 1ms servo-thread, and the joystick jog multi-stage signal-processing pipeline from analog-joystick-jog.hal. Every arrow is a named HAL net (pipe); every box is a filter.
svg.text: X-axis servo control pipeline — servo-thread addf sequence @ 1 ms

svg.text: Every arrow is a named HAL net (pipe) — e.g. net x-pos-cmd motion.0.x-pos-cmd pid.x.command
Filter taxonomy — every component reads pins → transforms → writes pins
